body:
## Fix

F1. Let CORE dev middleware parse query-bearing URLs instead of rejecting question marks before pathname extraction. Cache-busted core-release.json requests now reach the metadata handler.
F2. Preserve existing rejection of percent escapes, backslashes, and hashes. Add direct middleware regression expecting HTTP 200 without fallthrough.

## Validation

V1. Regression failed before fix and passed after fix.
V2. Parent reran build-tooling suite: 5 files, 17 tests passed. Parent inspected full middleware path handling, object allowlist, and regression assertions.
V3. Worker production build/vendor/browser-build verification passed; reproducibility check matched 76 files.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. Full headless/browser/E2E suites not run locally. Test directly invokes installed middleware; no visual UI change. CI remains separate.
title: fix(build): serve CORE metadata URLs with query strings
